name: Split Text
description: Splits a text into characters, words or lines and animates each piece in with a staggered GSAP reveal, triggered on scroll, load, hover or click, with optional looping, accent color and hover lift or wave.
contents: Single text element (configurable tag) split into chars, words or lines
Optional line or piece masks for clipped reveals
behavior: Waits for fonts to load, then splits the text with GSAP SplitText and hides it until ready
Staggered reveal of each piece using the chosen effect, started by ScrollTrigger on view, immediately on load, or replayed on hover or click
Optional loop replays conceal then reveal after a delay
Optional accent color flashes on each piece during reveal
Hover effect lift raises letters near the pointer with spring physics, wave sends a ripple across letters on pointer enter
Respects prefers-reduced-motion by showing the text without animation
Calls onLetterAnimationComplete once per text after the first reveal
editableByProps: Text, element tag, alignment, color, accent color and className
Split unit, stagger delay and origin, duration, easing, mask
Reveal effect, or fully custom from and to values
Trigger mode, scroll start threshold and margin, looping
fixed: Requires gsap with the club SplitText plugin, ScrollTrigger and @gsap/react
Registers GSAP plugins globally at import
Text must be a plain string, it is the only child and is re-split when it changes
Element is hidden (visibility hidden) until fonts load and the split completes
Parent is inline-block and clips overflow for rise, fade and custom from/to when hoverEffect is none
Lift and wave hover effects need a pointer, so they do nothing on touch screens
Cursor becomes pointer when trigger is click
Scroll start is computed from threshold and rootMargin and plays once
